value.rationale: The source identifies beta=1 as optimally fast for complete mixing; determining whether the same aggressive, operationally natural step remains convergent with non-complete two-node mixing and heterogeneous local curvature is a motivated structural question. The exact 1/3 negative-spectrum threshold, heterogeneity radical boundary and golden-ratio terminal threshold quantify distinct mixing/curvature interactions, including a sharp all-initializations nonconvergence witness at equality. This is not a renamed scalar stability computation: it characterizes the physically initialized network algorithm across its entire two-parameter class.
